title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: next best actions from Customer Intent Agent in the Copilot pane
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft's documentation supports administrator enablement, experience-profile access, the Dataverse update calls and the pay-as-you-go prerequisite. Minor corrections should make the profile-selection route explicit and acknowledge that several checklist controls have no corresponding table row.
